notes.title: Multiplayer beta OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h1]We are so back.[/h1][p][/p][p]After months of inactivity Olympic Hamster & Co. is back for the new major update of Where is the Tutorial, with a brand new gamemode: multiplayer (now on beta).[/p][p][/p][p]There was this guy on one review who said Where is the Tutorial was missing a multiplayer, so i at least i know Pootis Spencer is happy now.[/p][p][/p][p]The new gamemode is a bittttt diferent than the vanilla Where is the Tutorial as it is still on beta, and Olympic Hamster & Co. are still figuring out ways to improve the game and make it more challenging, still i want to insist it is 100% playable and there are no major bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]So get out there and find yourself how far can you get on the new multiplayer mode of Where is the Tutorial![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/467e075b7579c2979bdbdb180a09bb138f8b12f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/26037fef46ee9b28e72b8c640b699d48f29c7e16.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/2c8e1cb5568c9d8583dd1408b0dc59aabd72e668.jpg"][/img][/p][p]By the way, here at OlympicHamster & Co. want to update the game with more customization and different options to enjoy the multiplayer, so stay tuned we [b]WILL[/b] be back.[/p]

notes.title: The characters are alive!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello potential or current game investors![/h1]

Here at Olympic Hamster & Co. we have upgraded our beloved characters in order to improve not only the overall quality but also the available expressions and movements.

On top of fixing some "small" issues on the game mechanics:

[list]
[*]Singleplayer mode resetting when the player takes the tutorial for a second time
[*]Fire animation not rendering as intended
[*]Making the newspaper achievement actually achievable (sorry about this one)
[*]Other minor errors and performance problems
[/list]
Now the characters were re-drawn, with better quality and more expressions. Here are some side to side comparisons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/0c973dae95fe1a57b74aab7510d5c14e12884824.png[/img]

[h3]OLD JIMMY:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/d2fdc878bbf6f96258d21c47e9fd51f8ddf593ba.png[/img]

[h3]NEW JIMMY:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/b21650dd0a685f7ba6019ff1dc88b2d698a03641.png[/img]

And this is just the beginning, in the future Olympic Hamster & Co. is hoping to be adding many more animations, on top of the existing ones!

As always thanks for your support and we hope you are excited for future updates!

notes.title: New Year's update is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The release is finally out in new year! 🥳[/h1]

Containing all the mentioned features of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3003650/view/526455930526631816]previous article[/url], the new version of Where is the Tutorial is [b]out now[/b]. On top of the mentioned list, Olympic Hamster & Co. has also hidden some extra content, we encourage veteran players to look out for it!

With that said, the updated promotional content will take some extra time to make, but you can bet, here at Olympic Hamster & Co. are cooking the best of the [i]bestest[/i] marketing you can imagine (please don't get your expectations too high).

Olympic Hamster & Co. wishes all a happy 2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣5️⃣ and hope to see you, yes [b]YOU[/b] soon!

notes.title: Where is the Tutorial is getting a major update!
notes.content:
This winter, Where is the Tutorial will have a new, extense and overall incredible update including all the helpful feedback recieved since its release!

Keeping the game healthily frustrating, the update, focused on the quality of life of the experience will include such remarkable features as:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/c31cf8ff3c8777081780b22a7e30e2f5130c778f.png[/img]

Summary with more in depth information about the update:

[list]
[*]a brand new mysterious lever!
[*]new textures and map details!
[*]upgrades on the UI, with improvements on the graphics.
[*]easier and more intuitive mechanics, such as indicators to help out the player task's.
[*]fixes to some of the game's bugs, such as achivements not registering properly.
[*]and much more...
[/list]
Here at Olympic Hamster & Co. we know how long it took to release the update, but we promise to deliver with this overall improvement on the game, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do. So if you are still reading, and interested on the premise of this no-tutorial game, give it a chance!

We have already released full support for MacOS, and you can expect more updates on the way (although maybe not as fast as Olympic Hamster & Co. wished to deliver).

This update will be released around New Year's date, so expect it sooner rather than later!

notes.title: Where is the Tutorial is now for sale!
notes.content:
[h1]It is here.[/h1]

Attention everyone! The moment you've been eagerly anticipating is finally here. "Where is the Tutorial?" has just launched and is now available on Steam!

Starting now, you can dive headfirst into the most intriguing and puzzling adventure of the year. Forget everything you know about traditional gaming – this time, there’s no hand-holding, no straightforward instructions, and absolutely [b]no[/b] tutorial. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to navigate this bewildering world using nothing but your wits and instincts.

From the second you click ‘Play’ (if your are even able to find that button) you’ll be immersed in a paper crafted universe, teeming with intricate puzzles and hidden secrets. With no guidelines to follow, you’ll need to rely on your creativity and problem-solving skills to progress. Each environment is designed to be explored, each challenge to be deciphered, and each moment to be savored – all without a single hint.

Are you ready to take on the unknown? Ready to embark on an adventure where every step could lead to a new discovery or a dead end? Now’s your chance to prove it.

notes.title: Where is the Tutorial out in 12.1 hours
notes.content:
Are you ready to embark on the most confusing adventure of your life? We sure hope so, because "Where is the Tutorial?" is dropping in just 12.1 hours! Yes, you heard that right – exactly 12.1 hours. Why? Because who needs round numbers?

Get ready to be dropped into a game where the tutorial is...well, somewhere. Maybe. Or maybe not. We lost it. You’ll have to figure it out on your own. Think of it as a scavenger hunt, but without any clues. Or prizes. Or mercy.

Prepare your snacks, cancel your plans, and maybe stock up on aspirin – you’re going to need it. The adventure of a lifetime (or a very confusing afternoon) awaits you!

notes.title: Where is the Tutorial arriving in summer season!
notes.content:
[h1]Official launch date anouncment![/h1]

In two weeks from now: [b]27/6/24[/b], [b]Where is the tutorial[/b], the one and only game where rules are nowhere to be found, will be descending upon the steam store, public for everyone to buy and enjoy.

Making it just in time for the summer season, [b]Olympic Hamster & Co.[/b] will deliver this absolute masterpiece so you can enjoy hitting your head against a wall while getting absolutely scorched by the refreshing [i]highest[/i] temperatures that this season humbly provides us (unless you have access to an air conditioner, in which case maybe you can save yourself from this last suffering. But remember you won't save yourself from the one about the game, no, it's not possible).

So instead of going out and fighting against mother nature, get a hold of your chair and wait nervously for the official launch of [b]Where is the tutorial[/b]!

P.D: By the way here is some secret extra intel, as a reward for reading the announcements properly: expect some discounts around the time the game is out!
